roles.name: bg
roles.usage: Main canvas: chat area, dialogs' inner fields, inputs. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`, `accent`, `danger`.

roles.name: panel
roles.usage: Sidebar, detail panel, table header, chip and tag fill, status strip. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`, `accent`, `danger`.

roles.name: overlay
roles.usage: Floating layers only: menu, select popover, command palette, hover card, tooltip, toast, dialog. Always with `border` and `shadow-overlay`. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`.

roles.name: fg-muted
roles.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, timestamps, icons that are not the point. Holds 4.5:1 on `bg`, `panel`, `overlay`, `selected`, `hover`.

roles.name: border
roles.usage: Dividers and 1px outlines of inputs, cards, tables, popovers. Decorative; never the only signal of state.

roles.name: accent
roles.usage: The one accent: primary button fill, links, active mark, focus ring. Also usable as text on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay` (4.5:1). Never for status.

roles.name: on-accent
roles.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill. Equal to `bg` of the same theme.

roles.name: success
roles.usage: Mark only (dot, icon, thin bar): running, connected, succeeded. 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay`. The label next to it is `fg`.

roles.name: warning
roles.usage: Amber. Reserved for two things: spending money and deleting something that cannot be recovered. Never for "not logged in", "paused", "interrupted" or "attention". Mark only, 3:1.

roles.name: danger
roles.usage: Errors, interrupted or failed runs, destructive buttons. Usable as text (4.5:1) and as a fill under `on-danger`.

roles.name: on-danger
roles.usage: Text and icons on a `danger` fill. Equal to `bg` of the same theme.

roles.name: info
roles.usage: Neutral notices and "needs you" marks, including not logged in. Mark only, 3:1.

roles.name: selected
roles.usage: Neutral wash (fg at about 9-12%) behind the selected row, active menu item, current thread, active command-palette row. Never tinted by the brand, so all three projects share it. `fg` and `fg-muted` hold 4.5:1 on it over `bg`, `panel` and `overlay`.

roles.name: scrim
roles.usage: Dimming layer behind a drawer or modal on phones. Never carries text.

roles.name: hover
roles.usage: Translucent fg wash laid over any surface on hover; two layers on press. Never replaces `selected`.

roles.name: focus-ring
roles.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px, offset 2px. Same hue as `accent`; 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`.

market.name: up
market.usage: Market direction: price or value rose. Default = `palette-green`; `data-project="trade"` switches it to `palette-red` (A-share convention). Always paired with ▲ and a plus sign. Not `success`.

market.name: down
market.usage: Market direction: price or value fell. Default = `palette-red`; `data-project="trade"` switches it to `palette-green`. Always paired with ▼ and a minus sign. Not `danger`.

market.name: flat
market.usage: Market direction: unchanged, or no data. Same as `fg-muted`, shown as an en dash.
